feature_selection: none; all prespecified ablations reported; no outer-test winner deployment
fixed_control: V11 core expanded-grid r2 selections frozen for all variants; separates inputs from parameter changes
retuned_control: Identical V11 expanded grids, past-year Beimen OOF, r2 dispatch score; no outer labels for tuning
baseline_policy: Reconstruct selected previous same-weekday/calendar-matched days (56d, nearest4, at least2). Publication unverified, sensitivity only.
google_policy: 117 monthly raw records; <1 -> [0,1) interval, midpoint only for labelled descriptive/lag sensitivity; previous complete month, no current month or current year aggregate in predictors; metadata unverified.
